$comment: Atelier pre-render config for mermaid-cli (mmdc). Produces light-theme static SVG matching atelier.css tokens. Usage: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg --configFile mermaid-config.json --backgroundColor transparent. Pre-rendered SVG is single-theme by nature — pin its figure to the light paper (background:#FAF7F2) so it stays readable in dark mode. Keep in sync with the light token block in atelier.css.
fontFamily: Charter, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
